Mark missing inputs as `missing`, `partial`, or `operator_review_needed`; do not invent source facts.3. **Phase 3 — Normalize the project capture.** Convert the operator’s intent into a concise project goal, scope, non-goals, success criteria, constraints, assumptions, and open questions.4. **Phase 4 — Draft epics.** Group work into outcome-oriented epics.
